verdict.rationale: E2B's SDK is designed for fully programmatic lifecycle: agents can create a sandbox (Sandbox.create()), execute code/commands, read/write files and results, and tear it down (kill) or let it auto-expire via timeout — all via API/SDK with no human in the loop. Documentation covers creation, execution, filesystem I/O, metrics, and shutdown comprehensively, though a real-world community report notes agent loops requiring iteration/prompt tuning.
